main_text.p: fæm. præf. à sing. m. No. Rad. פות cardo
main_text.head: צ א
main_text.l: צֵאִי sordes, excrementum, No. s. m. Rad. יָצָא exivit.
צֵא exi, צְאוּ exite, צְאִי exi, f. צְאֶינָה exite, f. Imper. Kal, s. & pl. m. & f. Rad. יָצָא.
צֵאָה, צְאָה excrementum, No. s. f. Rad. יָצָא.
הַצֵּאִים fordidi, No. pl. m. Rad. יָצָא exivit.
צְאָלִים umbrosæ arbores, Job. 40. 16. No. pl. m. pro צְלָלִים, à f. m. צֵל Rad. צָלַל obumbrari, vel No. Rad. pl. m. Rad. צָאֵל umbrosum.
צֵאנְךָ grex ejus, צֹאנְךָ tuus, צֹאנֵנוּ noster, צֹאנֵנוּ greges nostri, Neh. 10. 37. s. & pl. m. aff. No. Rad. s. m. צֹאן.
main_text.head: צ ב
main_text.p: צַבָּה, צְבָה tumens, צְבִים currus camerati, No. s. m. & f. & pl. m. Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek are transcribed with approximate vowel pointing; the Hebrew forms on the scan are partly ambiguous and should be checked against the original. Line "צֵאָתְךָ" and "צֵאָתָם" readings are uncertain. The entry "pecorosus locus, No. s. m. à No. Rad. צֹאן o-vis" and "filii, prognati, צֵאֵצָאֶיךָ tui, No. pl. m. aff. Rad. יָצָא exivit", "צֵאת exire, (pro צֵאת,) צֵאתְךָ te, צֵאתוֹ ejus, Infin. Kal, aff. Rad. יָצָא", "צֵאֵת excrementum, צֵאֶתְךָ tuum, constr. s. f. aff. No. צֵאָה; Rad. יָצָא exivit", "צֵאת excrementum, וּמִצֵּאתוֹ & à sordibus suis, sing. fœm. constr. præf. & aff. No. צֵאָה excrementum, R. יָצָא" appear in the right column and are included in main_text as they stand in the scan; their Hebrew is not fully reproduced here and should be verified.
